objective:
Please deploy this repository as it is: contracts only, on Ethereum mainnet. There is no token and no owner.

It holds three contracts, to be created in this order: Questions, JobsReport, Payroll. Their constructor arguments are in docs/LAUNCH.md: six existing mainnet addresses (IMD, sIMD, the seat token, the seat Adapter, version 2 of the Intake and the oracle signer), the number 2000, three bytes32 feed ids, and two references to Questions. No argument is $owner: no contract has an owner, an admin or a setter.

Nothing has to be called after deployment. The constructors make no external call and check no code size, so they run on an empty chain. There is no proxy, no initializer, no pausing and no minting; the runtime bytecode holds no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT. forge test checks each of these statements (test/launch/LaunchManifest.t.sol).

The project builds with solc 0.8.26, EVM version cancun, optimizer 200 runs, via_ir, bytecode_hash = "none" and cbor_metadata = false, as foundry.toml already says. We believe no source file needs to change for the launch.

The manifest we expect (also in docs/LAUNCH.md, where a test checks it against the code):
{
 "kind": "evm_contracts",
 "contracts": [
  {
   "contract": "Questions",
   "constructorArgs": [
    "0xa43e6f75ee006411f79ac1c84120606c2330de82",
    "0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7",
    "0x5598aa9146215bc13eb26f2c692ad1461fd32982"
   ]
  },
  {
   "contract": "JobsReport",
   "constructorArgs": [
    "$contract:Questions",
    "0x4bf83605cd50e9658472bde9be314bb3848a563301fa793328bef17ad2a07b61",
    "0xfde22d9c1b97b7ce9763dff388a66366f9012d4ba7c57c3239377a75532bee4d",
    "0x22ad8df0e0af07aa59e29aa7f5540e0022fbfda0651ccae3eccb968553a14835"
   ]
  },
  {
   "contract": "Payroll",
   "constructorArgs": [
    "0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7",
    "0x9efa934d9fad4ae28c998a40195646b965a97247",
    "0x0000ec93127baa929e58e97dd0095a2bfb38ec1d",
    "2000",
    "0xde152afb7db5373f34876e1499fbd893a82dd336",
    "$contract:Questions",
    "0x4bf83605cd50e9658472bde9be314bb3848a563301fa793328bef17ad2a07b61",
    "0xfde22d9c1b97b7ce9763dff388a66366f9012d4ba7c57c3239377a75532bee4d",
    "0x22ad8df0e0af07aa59e29aa7f5540e0022fbfda0651ccae3eccb968553a14835"
   ]
  }
 ],
 "notes": "Contracts only. No token, no owner, nothing to call after deployment."
}
